name: Maria
source:
Maria, mostly adresses as mama by her children, is the family's matriarch.
She's the widow of Nhô Chico, a very much adored fisherman from Santa Maria.
Originally, she's from the island of São Nicolau.
She is a strict mother with a soft side.

[From [url=https://gongonstudio.itch.io/a-kiss-from-death]itch.io[/url]]
